spans.s:
mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be loosed or let go, to be liberated.
E.
मुच to let go, तव्य aff.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (मोक्षति मोक्षयति)
To let go, to release, to discharge, to send, to cast or throw.

m. (-क्षः)
1 Final and eternal happiness, the liberation of the soul from the body, and its exemption from further transmigration.
2

Liberation, freedom.
4 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali.
5 Acquittance of an obligation, as by a son to his father.
E.
मोक्ष to let loose or free, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what sets at liberty.
m. (-कः)
A deliverer, a liberator.
E.
मोक्ष, and ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Letting go or free, liberating.
2 Squandering.
E.
मोक्ष to let go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be, or what may be liberated.
E.
मोक्ष, and अनीयर् aff.; also मोक्ष्य and मोक्षितव्य.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Let go, liberated, at large.
E.
मोक्ष, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-यः)
A sage, a saint, a devotee.
E.
मोक्ष emancipation, उपाय means.
